author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Greetings avicus staff members. I am YouCantCMe/Zac. This is an appeal for my TS ban. I have appealed before but none of the senior mods who have denied me have actually bothered to justify the ban. I refuse to allow staff to get away with denying my appeal without evidence, a basis in the rules or the decency to discuss it with me. Pelpel also mentioned that the decision is final. This would imply it is unappealable. Please read my previous posts and the rules.
Thanks

title: Appeal for TS

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
The ban is justified, simple as that. So far, it seems your appeals revolve more around appealing against the responses and not the infraction. It's been explained, it's not tolerated behavior. Just because you don't agree with the rules doesn't mean they aren't rules. Appeal denied.

Regards,
Kavinsky.
